title: Chintamani Library v2.7.1 — Symmetrical 4D Member Action Controls, Luxury Executive Cards & Centered Brand Watermark
releaseNotes: SYMMETRICAL 4D MEMBER CONTROLS: All 15 member action buttons (WhatsApp, Edit, Renew, SMS, ID Card, Logs, Gift Days, etc.) redesigned with identical uniform dimensions
4D GRAPHIC BUTTONS: Tactile 3D embossed icon pods with jewel-tone glyphs and labels; button container surrounds streamlined to clean neutral dark obsidian glass without neon glare
CLEAN LUXURY MEMBER CARDS: Purged neon and bright glare from member ID cards, headers, and backgrounds; sleek dark titanium obsidian card surfaces with elegant gold trim
CENTERED WATERMARK BACKGROUND: Centered official ChintaMani insignia watermark rendered with calibrated transparency across app pages, keeping text and data 100% crisp and readable
OFFICIAL SCHOLAR ID PASS: Cleaned digital student ID pass modal with official library seal, QR code, and luxury gold styling
SEAMLESS OTA UPDATE: In-app instant auto-update delivery without manual APK installation
